title: Remove 🥺 emoji from all text everywhere in the app

requirements.summary: Remove every instance of the 🥺 emoji from all text in the frontend
acceptanceCriteria: The 🥺 emoji does not appear anywhere in the main page message (MainCard / App.tsx).
The 'You are my Patronus, Saachi' line no longer contains the 🥺 emoji.
The Yes button label contains no 🥺 emoji.
All messages and lines on the CelebrationScreen contain no 🥺 emoji.
All quips in RunawayButton contain no 🥺 emoji.
No other component or string literal in the frontend contains the 🥺 emoji.
All other text, styling, and functionality remains unchanged.

file_operations.description: Remove all 🥺 emoji instances from the MainCard message text, including the 'Saachi, can we reconnect?' message and the 'You are my Patronus, Saachi' line, and from the Yes button label. Preserve all other text, styling, Harry Potter theme elements, and functionality.

Remove all 🥺 emoji instances from all messages and text displayed on the celebration screen, including the animated message that appears after the user clicks Yes. Keep all other emojis (✨, ⚡, etc.), confetti effects, animations, and styling intact.

Remove all 🥺 emoji instances from every quip in the quips array that displays when the button runs away. Preserve all other Harry Potter-themed text, the runaway behavior, and all other functionality.
